post.script: Duniya ke sabse advanced military weapons actually insanon ne nahi, balki machhliyon ne invent kiye hain. Number teen par hai archerfish, jo apne muh ko ek pressurized sniper rifle ki tarah use karti hai. Yeh instant light refraction calculate karke paani ki bullet marti hai, aur keede seedhe paani mein gir jaate hain. Number do par hai stoplight loosejaw, ek deep sea fish jiske paas in built night vision system hai. Deep sea ke animals ko sirf blue light dikhti hai, par yeh predator ek secret red light beam produce karta hai. Isse yeh ghor andhere mein bhi prey ko dekh leta hai, jabki khud unke liye completely invisible rehta hai. Aur number ek par hai electric eel, jo shock dene se bhi zyada dangerous kaam karti hai. Pehle yeh paani mein high voltage electromagnetic signals bhejti hai, jo chhupi hui machhliyon tak pahunchte hain. Yeh signal victim ke nervous system ko hijack kar lete hain, aur unke muscles apne aap twitch hone lagte hain. Aur jab wo twitch karti hain tab eel ke brain ko unka location pata chal jata hai, aur wo full power blast karti hai. Isse yeh prove hota hai ki science se pehle nature ne yeh sab kar dikhaya tha.

post.script: Duniya ka sabse bada waterfall zameen par nahi, actually samandar ke paani ke neeche chupa hua hai. Denmark Strait mein Arctic ka ekdam thanda paani south ki taraf behkar Atlantic ke garm paani se takrata hai. Science ka seedha niyam hai, thanda paani garm paani ke muqable bahut zyada dense aur bhaari hota hai. Phir jaise hi ye dono currents milti hain, bhaari barfeela paani seedhe samandar ki gehrai mein neeche doobne lagta hai. Ye paani ek bahut bade underwater cliff se seedhe sadhe gyarah hazaar feet neeche girta hai. Matlab zameen ke sabse oonche waterfall Angel Falls se bhi teen guna zyada bada drop. Aur har single second mein tees lakh cubic meter paani is drop se neeche beh jaata hai. Ye bahaav ek hazaar se bhi zyada Niagara Falls ke paani ko ek saath milane jitna hai. Lekin agar aap theek iske upar boat chalaoge, toh samandar ki satah aapko bilkul normal aur shaant dikhegi. Kyunki kudrat ka sabse vishaal waterfall samandar ki gehraiyon mein chupchaap beh raha hai.
